issue_context.title: [Feat]: Add context switches per application group to the apps plugin
issue_context.body:
### Problem

Add chart for voluntary and nonvoluntary context switches per application group. 

### Description

`voluntary_ctxt_switches` and `nonvoluntary_ctxt_switches` are important indications of which processes might lead to thrashing. 
While the param values are available per process ( see https://community.netdata.cloud/t/apps-plugin-high-cpu-usage/1425/8),
we are not collecting these values.

### Importance

nice to have

### Value proposition

Users will be able to identify the process groups that might be causing system wide excessive context switching.


### Proposed implementation

Add to this list:
https://github.com/netdata/netdata/blob/3194286467665f2c138cd3f9a0eb3bdac265f937/collectors/apps.plugin/apps_plugin.c#L1313-L1320

review_comments: Why only `switches/s`? The unit of the chart is `context switch`.
The unit of both charts is `switches/s`. Where did you find `context switch`?
Because we are not only talking about `switches`, we are here talking about `context switches`, but let us move ahead, this is a minor. :handshake:
MAC OS, is `__FreeBSD__` enough for both?
No, it is not enough. But apps.plugin has **never** been working on macOS (read as there is no apps.plugin on macOS).
